panels.title: Requests/s (5m)
panels.description: Client requests per second. Retry attempts are excluded; use the failover panel for upstream attempts.

panels.title: Spend (24h)
panels.description: Estimated USD over 24h — priced (ondemand) models only.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests currently being routed (global, ignores filters).

panels.title: Degraded serves (1h)
panels.description: Requests served below the requested grade.

panels.title: Error rate (1h)
panels.description: Client-facing 4xx/5xx as a percentage of requests in the last hour.

panels.title: Stream TTFB p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time-to-first-byte for streaming responses.

panels.title: Stale quota providers
panels.description: Providers whose quota numbers are the last good ones, not live.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since daemon start.

panels.title: Requests/s by pool
panels.description: Client requests per second grouped by routing pool.

panels.title: Requests/s by provider
panels.description: Provider prefix from the model id. DeepSeek appears here as deepseek (direct) or or (through OpenRouter).

panels.title: Requests/s by target model (top 10)
panels.description: Busiest upstream models in the selected time range. Filter the dashboard by Model or Provider to drill in.

panels.title: Tokens/s by model and direction
panels.description: Upstream tokens per second, split into input and output.

panels.title: Spend rate by caller (USD/h)
panels.description: Estimated spend per hour, by caller. Only priced models contribute.

panels.title: Spend rate by provider (USD/h)
panels.description: Estimated spend per hour, grouped by provider prefix from model.

panels.title: Spend rate by model (USD/h)
panels.description: Estimated spend per hour, by upstream model.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: End-to-end request latency (includes failover attempts), by pool, caller, model, and provider.

panels.title: Stream TTFB p50 / p95
panels.description: Time-to-first-byte for streaming responses.

panels.title: Responses/s by HTTP status
panels.description: All client-facing responses, split by HTTP status and routing outcome.

panels.title: Quota window utilization
panels.description: Per provider and window, from native fetches, header harvests, or manual overrides (100 = exhausted).

panels.title: Drain countdown (use-it-or-lose-it)
panels.description: Seconds until a draining window resets; -1 means no window is draining.

panels.title: Quota staleness
panels.description: 1 when the provider's quota numbers are the last good ones, not live.

panels.title: Models available by pool / grade
panels.description: Models visible in the default profile, grouped by pool and grade.

panels.title: Model health state
panels.description: 0 = healthy, 1 = cooling down after errors, 2 = circuit open (excluded from routing). Populated from in-memory health at scrape time.

panels.title: Model cooldown countdown
panels.description: Seconds until the model's cooldown or circuit-open period expires; 0 means the model is eligible again.

panels.title: Model failure ratio (1h)
panels.description: Health-window failure ratio. The default circuit opens above 30% once at least 8 samples are available.

panels.title: Quota provider mapping
panels.description: Join key between model-provider prefixes (provider) and aitop quota panels (quota_provider). The Quota provider filter uses panel names.

panels.title: DeepSeek balance available
panels.description: Provider-reported spendability flag for the selected provider. DeepSeek direct is fetched natively from /user/balance.

panels.title: DeepSeek balance age
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful balance fetch. DeepSeek is polled with the configured quota poll interval.

panels.title: DeepSeek account balance by currency
panels.description: Absolute account balance reported by the provider. DeepSeek returns decimal strings per currency (typically USD or CNY); no FX conversion is applied.

panels.title: DeepSeek requests/s by model
panels.description: Requests served by any DeepSeek model, whether configured as deepseek/... or reached through another provider prefix.

panels.title: DeepSeek tokens/s by direction
panels.description: DeepSeek input/output token throughput.

panels.title: DeepSeek spend rate by model (USD/h)
panels.description: Estimated DeepSeek spend per hour. Direct DeepSeek API and OpenRouter-hosted DeepSeek models both match.

panels.title: DeepSeek errors/s
panels.description: DeepSeek 4xx/5xx responses by routing outcome and model.

panels.title: DeepSeek latency p95 by model
panels.description: 95th percentile end-to-end latency for DeepSeek models.

panels.title: DeepSeek error ratio by model
panels.description: DeepSeek 4xx/5xx as a percentage of requests, by model.

panels.title: HTTP errors/s by source → target
panels.description: Client-facing 4xx/5xx responses. source_model is the requested model; target_model is the selected upstream or none when routing exhausted.

panels.title: Upstream attempts/s by status
panels.description: Individual upstream attempts, including retries and failover.
